$description: AudioFool Android sizes, in dp (text in sp). Colours, shadows and radii come from theme-tokens.json (PS1 Light) and theme-tokens.dark.json (PS2 Dark), copied unchanged from the desktop. This file holds everything mobile-only and is the same in both themes, apart from the colour block at the top. Values match design/android-spec.md.

color.$note: Mobile-only colours, one value per theme. Every other colour is a desktop token. bpLabel was Now Playing's BP button's label; since 2026-11-10 Bit-Perfect is a row in the cover menu, checked in the desktop's status.bitPerfectOn, so nothing draws bpLabel now. Kept so the button could come back as it was.

font.$note: Segoe UI can't be bundled. Selawik is Microsoft's open-source (OFL) stand-in with Segoe UI's metrics, bundled (the user's call, session 1): Regular, Semibold and Bold, which have tabular digits by default.

topBar.$logoBarNote: Artists' bar: the search field from the left, then the logo in its 48 dp touch area at the right (2026-11-10, the user's call; the logo was at the left, with these two the other way round). So the field starts 12 dp from the edge, as Search's does, and the logo sits 4 + 6 dp from the right edge.

panel.$tabGapNote: Artists' header tabs, ARTISTS and PLAYLISTS (2026-11-12, the user's request): the gap between the two labels, each label's touch area reaching half of it either side.

index.$note: The letter strip at the list's right edge (0.2.0, the user's call; no mockup): always shown since 0.2.1, with the rows ending width + 2 × marginEnd from the panel's edge. A pill in the panel's colours; the letters text.muted, the current one text.primary at activeWeight. While a finger is on it, the bubble (the logo menu's surface) shows the letter in text.heading in the middle of the list. Albums' year strip (0.11.0) uses the same sizes: labels closer than minSlot are thinned to one written label per run, and the bubble grows past its square for a year, bubblePaddingX either side.

album.$note: The # column starts at the row's start, numbers left-aligned; it is columns.number.width (two digits) or the album's longest number if wider (100+ tracks, a large font). The playing song shows the triangle in its number's place (2026-11-06, the user's call; the mockup had a triangle slot left of a right-aligned number).

menu.$note: The logo menu (spec 4.1: Library Statistics, Listening History, Rescan Library, Settings, Theme, in alphabetical order, then the version). No mockup: a panel under the logo with settings-sized rows (session 2). Since the logo moved right (2026-11-10), the menu's right edge is offsetX in from the logo's touch area, so it lines up with the panel below. checkIcon: a ticked row's check (the cover menu's Bit-Perfect).

artMenu.$note: Now Playing's cover menu (0.6.0, the user's call): a tap on the cover opens it at the finger (a long press until 2026-11-10). The logo menu's look and rows (menu.*). The first row, the cover's resolution, opens the cover full screen (coverViewer; information only until 2026-11-10); then Analyze, Bit-Perfect, Genius, Theme and the version. Kept edgeMargin inside the screen.

coverViewer.$note: The cover full screen (spec 5.3; 2026-11-10, the user's call), from the cover menu's Resolution row. The picture is decoded whole, halved until no side is over maxDecodeSide px, and fitted inside the system bars. Pinch zooms up to maxZoom times the fitted size; a double tap zooms to doubleTapZoom at the finger, or back out.

analysis.$note: Analyze (0.6.0): the desktop's Analysis window as a screen. The colour scale (floorDb, topDb, legendStepDb), the label spacings and the cutoff marker are the desktop's analysis.* tokens; these are the phone's sizes. The picture is a fraction of the screen height, as Now Playing's buttons are.

predictiveBack.$note: The screen being left during the back gesture (session 2): it shrinks to `scale` and moves `shift` dp toward the swipe, then slides off in `commitMs` milliseconds.

lastFm.$note: Settings' Last.fm panel while connecting (spec 7). No mockup: the username and password fields (the key and secret until 0.8.0) are drawn as the search field is, the buttons as chips (session 5).

statistics.$note: Statistics (spec 4.6). No mockup: the desktop's Statistics window (tiles of type.statValue figures, labelled bars in slider.volumeFill on slider.track, playbackBar.trackHeight high) fitted to a phone in two columns (session 5).

listeningHistory.$note: Listening History (spec 4.7). No mockup: the desktop's Listening History window (session 74) built from Statistics' parts (statistics.*), in one column. The period switch is six short words (7D … All) in equal slots, a touch target high; the chosen one in text.heading at the desktop's dialog.emphasisWeight. Under a row's bar, the artist (or artist · album) detailGap below.

genius.$note: The Genius screen (spec 5.2), from the cover menu. No mockup: the desktop's Genius window (session 75) in one column, built from the album header (album.*) and Statistics' panels and rows (statistics.*). Inside a section: sectionPaddingY above and below; entries (a question, an annotation, a comment) entryGap apart, the heading and its right-hand figure (columnGap apart), then the text bodyGap below. Credits and connections: the label in a creditLabelWidth column, columnGap before the names, rows creditGap apart. The header's 'Open on Genius' link is linkGap under the details.

tagEdit.$note: The Edit Tags screen (spec 5.4), from the cover menu. No mockup: the desktop's Edit Track Tags window (tagEdit.* in its tokens) in one panel. Each row: the label in a labelWidth column (two lines at most), labelGap, then the box (fieldHeight; Year yearWidth; each number numberWidth with 'of' ofGap either side); rows rowGap apart, the panel's content padded paddingX / paddingY. A detail's clear button (clearButton square, clearIcon) sits clearButtonGap right of its box. Comments grows from commentMinHeight to commentMaxHeight, then scrolls. The footer under the panel: the message (footerTextSize) and Save, footerGap apart, footerPaddingY above and below. The prompt at system back with changes: promptWidth wide, promptPadding inside, promptGap between its title, text and buttons.

update.$note: The update pop-up (spec 9; 2026-11-12, the user's request), over whatever screen is showing. No mockup: drawn as Edit Tags' prompt (tagEdit.prompt*). promptWidth wide, promptPadding inside, promptGap between the title (titleSize, the desktop's dialog.emphasisWeight), the text (textSize) and the row of buttons, buttonGap apart at the right.
update.$noteNote: The note a tap on the menus' Version row shows instead of the pop-up (2026-11-12, the user's call): "Checking for updates…", then "No new version available" or "Couldn't check for updates", gone after noteMs (the user: "disappears after 2 seconds"). The pop-up's panel, centred, no dimming and no buttons; one line of textSize, notePaddingX at the sides and notePaddingY above and below, at most promptWidth wide.

lyrics.$note: The Lyrics screen (spec 5.5; 2026-11-11, the user's request), from the cover menu. No mockup; the header is Analyze's (analysis.header*, titleSize, titleWeight, subtitleSize). Each line lineSize at lineWeight, paddingX each side and linePaddingY above and below (its tap area); the line being sung grows to currentScale from its left edge, every line laid out narrow enough to grow inside the padding; a break between verses (or a timed pause) is breakHeight. The list keeps the line being sung anchor of its height down; a finger's scroll stops that until followAgainMs after it lets go. Colour and size change over changeMs; the line is read every tickMs while playing. Under the lyrics, where they came from: sourceSize, sourceTop above it.

nowPlaying.$spareNote: 0.2.3 (the user's call): the spare height is the screen's height less artHeightReserve, the font growth and the cover's side: none on the M21 (its cover is limited by the height), about 120 dp on the S24 (limited by the width). The waveform grows by waveformGrowth.ofSpare of it, up to max, and the space below the times grows toward the space above's weight, level with it at spareEvenAt dp of spare. With no spare nothing changes.
nowPlaying.$controlsLiftNote: 0.2.4 (the user's call: the S24's buttons sat too close to the bottom to press comfortably): controlsLift.ofSpare of the spare height, up to max, goes between the controls row and the readout, so the six buttons rise and the readout stays where it was. None on the M21. 0.2.5 (the user: "slightly higher"): 0.2 / 24 dp became 0.33 / 40 dp; 0.2.6 ("a little higher" again): 0.46 / 56 dp.
nowPlaying.$readoutLiftNote: 0.7.1 (the user's call: the S24's output readout sat awkwardly close to the bottom): readoutLift.ofSpare of the spare height, up to max, is taken out of the controlsLift gap and put under the readout, so the readout rises and the buttons stay put. Kept smaller than controlsLift. None on the M21.
nowPlaying.$modeNote: 2026-11-10 (the user's call; BP moved to the cover menu): Repeat over Shuffle at the left, modeGap apart, the two as tall as Play/Pause (Repeat's top level with its top, Shuffle's bottom with its bottom), so each is (playButton - modeGap) / 2 within modeButton.min and max: 44 dp on the S24, 35 on the M21. The icon is modeIconOfButton of the button. Previous, Play/Pause and Next centred on the screen. At least modeToTransportGap between Repeat and Shuffle and Previous; where the screen is too narrow (the S24), the transport's gaps shrink to transportGap.fitMin at most, then Previous and Next shrink (the S24: 8 dp gaps, 60 dp buttons). From 0.2.2 until then: 34 dp buttons, Repeat and Shuffle side by side with BP under them, and the transport at the right.
nowPlaying.$coverAccentNote: The cover's colour on Now Playing (2026-11-09, the user's calls: "the main color theme of the album art" for the seekbar, the colour around Play/Pause and its icon; then also Repeat and Shuffle when on, the artist's name and, until it went on 2026-11-10, the glow at the top; and from 2026-11-10 the mini player's three buttons, icons, ring and glow). The cover's main hue (core CoverColor) at a lightness within lightnessRange of the theme colour it stands in for (accent.playback, for the artist's name too since 2026-11-11), on the side away from the background: that or lighter on Dark, that or darker on Light (OKLab lightness, 0 black to 1 white). A black and white cover gives a grey (2026-11-11), fitted as a colour is on Light and greyOnDark light on Dark (OKLab lightness, about #E0E0E0: the user's call, "Brighter on Dark"); only no cover keeps the theme's colours. ring: where the theme's own ring round Play/Pause is clear (control.playRing in Light), the cover's colour makes one this wide at this opacity; where the theme has a ring (Dark), the cover's colour takes that ring's width and opacity.
nowPlaying.$scrubBubbleNote: The time under the finger while the seekbar is dragged (2026-11-09, the user's call): the index strips' bubble surface, at least minWidth wide and height tall, paddingX either side of the time, centred over the finger and kept inside the bar's ends. Its foot is gap above the bar's top: clear of the quality line (waveformTop + the line + a little), where a thumb doesn't hide it.
nowPlaying.$swipeNote: Swipe the art or the title block sideways (0.2.0, the user's call, replacing swipe-down to close): left is Next, right is the song before however far into this one (2026-11-11). Both follow the finger and fade toward swipeFadeTo over the art's width; let go past swipeSkipDistance, or flung faster than swipeSkipVelocity (dp/s), and the song changes; otherwise they spring back. Lowered 2026-11-11 (from 96 dp and 1200 dp/s, the user's call: too stiff).
